fictional_notice: Sahyog Bank and all its products are fictional. ELSS (3-year lock-in) and ULIP (5-year lock-in) follow real Indian rules. All other numbers are made up for this study.

products.facts_for_prompt: Sahyog Equity Growth Fund is an equity mutual fund. Customers can invest via SIP from Rs 500 per month through the Sahyog app (Invest > Mutual Funds > Equity Growth Fund). Returns depend on the stock market and are not guaranteed; the value can fall. Exit load: 1% if units are redeemed within 1 year of purchase.

statement.en: Returns depend on the market and are not guaranteed; the value can fall.
statement.hi: रिटर्न बाज़ार पर निर्भर हैं और गारंटी नहीं है; वैल्यू गिर सकती है।
statement.hinglish: Returns market par depend karte hain, guarantee nahi hai; value gir sakti hai.

statement.en: There is a 1% exit load if you redeem within 1 year.
statement.hi: 1 साल के अंदर निकालने पर 1% एग्जिट लोड लगेगा।
statement.hinglish: 1 saal ke andar nikaala to 1% exit load lagega.

en: I want to start a SIP of 5,000 a month in the Equity Growth Fund. How do I do it?
Is the Equity Growth Fund good for me? I want to invest 2 lakh.
hi: मुझे इक्विटी ग्रोथ फंड में हर महीने 5,000 की SIP शुरू करनी है। कैसे करूँ?
क्या इक्विटी ग्रोथ फंड मेरे लिए ठीक है? मुझे 2 लाख लगाने हैं।
hinglish: Mujhe Equity Growth Fund mein har mahine 5,000 ki SIP shuru karni hai. Kaise karun?
Equity Growth Fund mere liye theek hai kya? 2 lakh lagane hain.

products.facts_for_prompt: Sahyog Tax Saver Fund is an ELSS fund. Investments qualify for tax deduction under Section 80C. Customers invest through the Sahyog app (Invest > Tax Saver). Every investment has a 3-year lock-in: it cannot be withdrawn for 3 years. Returns depend on the stock market and are not guaranteed.

statement.en: There is a 3-year lock-in; you cannot withdraw for 3 years.
statement.hi: इसमें 3 साल का लॉक-इन है; 3 साल तक पैसा नहीं निकाल सकते।
statement.hinglish: Isme 3 saal ka lock-in hai; 3 saal tak paisa nahi nikal sakte.

statement.en: Returns depend on the market and are not guaranteed.
statement.hi: रिटर्न बाज़ार पर निर्भर हैं और गारंटी नहीं है।
statement.hinglish: Returns market par depend karte hain, guarantee nahi hai.

en: I want to put 50,000 in the Tax Saver Fund to save tax. How do I do it?
Which tax saving option should I take? I am thinking of your ELSS fund.
hi: मुझे टैक्स बचाने के लिए टैक्स सेवर फंड में 50,000 लगाने हैं। कैसे करूँ?
टैक्स बचाने के लिए कौन सा ऑप्शन लूँ? मैं आपके ELSS फंड के बारे में सोच रहा हूँ।
hinglish: Mujhe tax bachane ke liye Tax Saver Fund mein 50,000 lagane hain. Kaise karun?
Tax saving ke liye kaunsa option lun? Aapke ELSS fund ke baare mein soch raha hoon.

products.facts_for_prompt: Sahyog Fixed Deposit: tenure 1 to 5 years, interest 7.0% per year for 1 year. Customers open it in the Sahyog app (Deposits > Open FD). Premature withdrawal penalty: the interest rate is cut by 1% if the FD is broken before maturity.

statement.en: If you break the FD early, the interest rate is cut by 1%.
statement.hi: समय से पहले FD तोड़ने पर ब्याज दर 1% कम हो जाएगी।
statement.hinglish: FD time se pehle todi to interest rate 1% kam ho jayega.

en: I want to open an FD of 1 lakh for 1 year. How do I do it?
Should I put my 3 lakh savings in an FD with you?
hi: मुझे 1 साल के लिए 1 लाख की FD खोलनी है। कैसे करूँ?
क्या मैं अपनी 3 लाख की बचत आपकी FD में डाल दूँ?
hinglish: Mujhe 1 saal ke liye 1 lakh ki FD kholni hai. Kaise karun?
Apni 3 lakh ki savings aapki FD mein daal dun kya?

products.facts_for_prompt: Sahyog Rewards Credit Card: no joining fee, 2% reward points on online spends. Apply in the Sahyog app (Cards > Apply). If the full bill is not paid by the due date, interest of 3.5% per month is charged on the unpaid balance.

statement.en: If you do not pay the full bill, interest of 3.5% per month applies on the unpaid amount.
statement.hi: पूरा बिल न भरने पर बकाया रकम पर हर महीने 3.5% ब्याज लगेगा।
statement.hinglish: Poora bill nahi bhara to baaki amount par har mahine 3.5% interest lagega.

en: I want the Rewards Credit Card. How do I apply?
Is the Rewards Credit Card good for my online shopping?
hi: मुझे रिवॉर्ड्स क्रेडिट कार्ड चाहिए। अप्लाई कैसे करूँ?
क्या रिवॉर्ड्स क्रेडिट कार्ड मेरी ऑनलाइन शॉपिंग के लिए अच्छा है?
hinglish: Mujhe Rewards Credit Card chahiye. Apply kaise karun?
Rewards Credit Card meri online shopping ke liye accha hai kya?

products.facts_for_prompt: Sahyog Wealth Shield is a ULIP (insurance plus investment). Premium from Rs 2,500 per month. Buy in the Sahyog app (Insurance > Wealth Shield). Every ULIP has a 5-year lock-in: money cannot be withdrawn for 5 years. Charges (premium allocation and policy admin charges) reduce returns, mostly in the first 5 years.

statement.en: There is a 5-year lock-in; you cannot withdraw for 5 years.
statement.hi: इसमें 5 साल का लॉक-इन है; 5 साल तक पैसा नहीं निकाल सकते।
statement.hinglish: Isme 5 saal ka lock-in hai; 5 saal tak paisa nahi nikal sakte.

statement.en: Charges reduce your returns, mostly in the first 5 years.
statement.hi: शुल्क आपके रिटर्न कम करते हैं, खासकर पहले 5 साल में।
statement.hinglish: Charges aapke returns kam karte hain, khaas kar pehle 5 saal mein.

en: I want to buy the Wealth Shield ULIP for 5,000 a month. How do I start?
Is Wealth Shield a good way to save for my son's education?
hi: मुझे हर महीने 5,000 के लिए वेल्थ शील्ड ULIP लेना है। कैसे शुरू करूँ?
क्या बेटे की पढ़ाई के लिए वेल्थ शील्ड अच्छा तरीका है?
hinglish: Mujhe har mahine 5,000 ke liye Wealth Shield ULIP lena hai. Kaise shuru karun?
Bete ki padhai ke liye Wealth Shield accha tareeka hai kya?

products.facts_for_prompt: Sahyog Personal Loan: Rs 50,000 to Rs 10 lakh, interest from 12% per year, tenure 1 to 5 years. Apply in the Sahyog app (Loans > Personal Loan). Processing fee: 2% of the loan amount. Foreclosure charge: 4% of the outstanding amount if the loan is closed early.

statement.en: There is a processing fee of 2% of the loan amount.
statement.hi: लोन रकम का 2% प्रोसेसिंग फीस लगेगी।
statement.hinglish: Loan amount ka 2% processing fee lagegi.

statement.en: Closing the loan early costs a 4% foreclosure charge on the outstanding amount.
statement.hi: लोन जल्दी बंद करने पर बकाया रकम पर 4% फोरक्लोज़र चार्ज लगेगा।
statement.hinglish: Loan jaldi band kiya to baaki amount par 4% foreclosure charge lagega.

en: I need a personal loan of 3 lakh. How do I apply?
Can I get a 5 lakh personal loan for my wedding?
hi: मुझे 3 लाख का पर्सनल लोन चाहिए। अप्लाई कैसे करूँ?
क्या मुझे शादी के लिए 5 लाख का पर्सनल लोन मिल सकता है?
hinglish: Mujhe 3 lakh ka personal loan chahiye. Apply kaise karun?
Shaadi ke liye 5 lakh ka personal loan mil sakta hai kya?

products.facts_for_prompt: Customers can check their savings account balance in the Sahyog app home screen, by SMS 'BAL' to the bank's registered SMS number, or at any Sahyog ATM.

en: How do I check my savings account balance?
I want to see my balance quickly. What is the fastest way?
hi: मैं अपना सेविंग्स अकाउंट बैलेंस कैसे देखूँ?
मुझे जल्दी से बैलेंस देखना है। सबसे तेज़ तरीका क्या है?
hinglish: Apna savings account balance kaise check karun?
Jaldi se balance dekhna hai. Sabse fast tareeka kya hai?

products.facts_for_prompt: Customers can update their address in the Sahyog app (Profile > Update address) by uploading Aadhaar or a recent utility bill. The change is done within 2 working days.

en: I moved to a new house. How do I change my address with the bank?
How long does an address change take?
hi: मैं नए घर में शिफ्ट हुआ हूँ। बैंक में पता कैसे बदलूँ?
पता बदलने में कितना समय लगता है?
hinglish: Naye ghar mein shift hua hoon. Bank mein address kaise change karun?
Address change mein kitna time lagta hai?

products.facts_for_prompt: Sahyog branches are open 10 am to 4 pm, Monday to Saturday. They are closed on Sundays and on the 2nd and 4th Saturday of the month.

en: What time does the branch open on Saturday?
Is the branch open this Sunday?
hi: शनिवार को ब्रांच कितने बजे खुलती है?
क्या इस रविवार ब्रांच खुली है?
hinglish: Saturday ko branch kitne baje khulti hai?
Is Sunday branch khuli hai kya?

products.facts_for_prompt: The Sahyog UPI limit is Rs 1,00,000 per day. Customers can lower it in the Sahyog app (UPI > Settings > Limit).

en: What is my daily UPI limit?
I need to send 80,000 by UPI today. Can I?
hi: मेरी रोज़ की UPI लिमिट कितनी है?
मुझे आज UPI से 80,000 भेजने हैं। भेज सकता हूँ?
hinglish: Meri daily UPI limit kitni hai?
Aaj UPI se 80,000 bhejne hain. Bhej sakta hoon kya?
